rationale: Possessable noun appearing twice in lines 7-8 in parallel construction with trees-and-roots imagery. 'Trees fashioned with their X' / 'each fashioned with his X in the cosmos' supports a sense of rooting/grounding. Possibly cognate with ⲁⲙⲁϩⲧⲉ 'grasp, hold' qualitative — what holds the cosmic god in place. Confidence low.

Greek θλίβειν/θλῖψις 'press, afflict, oppress' adopted as Coptic verb/noun. With locative-stative ⲟ̄ⲛⲟⲩ 'is in', construes a state-of-being-pressed. Fits the Manichaean motif of cosmic gods bound in the world.

Verb of negative action upon the soul, parallel with 'drawing her at every hour to evil works.' Possibly Lyc reflex of ϫⲱⲗ 'twist, deceive' or a constraint-verb. Etymology unclear; flagged for parallel research.

Qualitative plural of ⲡⲣⲓⲉ 'shine, radiate' — same root as ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ 'the Radiance' (in glossary). Used here of the Five Gods/Sons of the Living Spirit who are radiant. Preserves the active-emission verb-quality per correspondential principle.
Already in earlier glossary as ⲡⲙⲟⲟⲙⲉ; this page uses spelling ⲡⲙⲟⲙⲉ (single ⲟ). Both reflect Coptic ⲙⲟⲩⲙⲉ 'vein, channel.' Third body-part in the five-faculty correspondence.

Verbal compound ⲣ̄- ('do') + ⲟ̄ⲁⲭⲏ (possibly Greek ἀρχή 'rule, principle, beginning'). Used in negative-cult context preceding 'serving the beasts.' Sense uncertain; possibly 'they hold to a (false) principle' or 'they exercise (false) rule.' Flagged for parallels.
